visual.description: Dark bg. Large counter animates up to '$680B' in #D47FA6 accent, center screen. Below: comparison card — two flag icons (Portugal + New Zealand) with their combined GDP shown. Visual equivalence: '$680B lost to sleep > Portugal + New Zealand GDP combined'. Subtle smoke/dissolve effect on the number to match 'going up in smoke' line.

comparison.message: Lost every year. Not from war. Not from crisis. From not sleeping.

notes: $680B is aggregate of high-end estimates across 5 countries. Portugal + NZ comparison added per script-v2 revision. ⚠️ FLAG #7: Do NOT extrapolate to '$1T globally' — RAND only measured 5 countries. $680B is the five-country total, not a global estimate.
